title: Snapshot
description:
Portfolio totals as at one date. Source of truth: docs/DATA_MODEL.md section 'Derived' and docs/ENGINE_SPEC.md section 8.

A persisted snapshot is a CACHE OF A DERIVATION, not a source of truth. It must always remain recomputable from the ledger. Storing these daily is what later unlocks the portfolio-value chart and TWRR.

as_of.description: Always passed in explicitly. The engine never reads the clock, because that would make tests non-deterministic and historical replay impossible.

realised_to_date.description: Cumulative realised gain across every sell up to as_of.
